name: Nahanni National Park Reserve
policyReason: The park only requires dogs to be leashed and lists no bans.
summary: Dogs are allowed on a leash at all times; Parks Canada suggests leaving them home in bear country.

excerpts.quote: Dogs can provoke defensive behaviour in bears.

dogRules.text: Keep dogs leashed at all times; dogs can provoke bears.
Hang or store pet food away from your tent.
